_comment: Edit food card text here. correctAnswer must be one of: dog, cat, both, neither, ask-grown-up. image path is under public/assets/.

imageAlt.zhHant: 乾淨盤子上的清煮雞胸肉塊
imageAlt.en: Pieces of plain cooked chicken breast on a clean plate

preparation.zhHant: 完全煮熟，沒有骨頭、沒有皮、沒有調味、沒有醬汁，已放涼且新鮮。
preparation.en: Fully cooked, no bones, no skin, no seasoning, no sauce, still cool and fresh.

clues.zhHant: 骨頭可能會傷害寵物。
clues.en: Bones can hurt pets.

clues.zhHant: 鹽、洋蔥和大蒜醬料並不安全。
clues.en: Salt, onion and garlic sauces are not safe.

clues.zhHant: 大人同意時，狗和貓都可以分享清煮的肉。
clues.en: Both dogs and cats can share plain cooked meat when a grown-up says yes.

explanation.zhHant: 沒有骨頭、沒有調味的清煮雞肉，狗和貓都可能可以吃——但一定要先問大人。這個遊戲不會決定真正的餐點。
explanation.en: Plain cooked chicken without bones or seasoning can be okay for dogs and cats — but only if a grown-up checks first. This game never decides a real meal.

imageAlt.zhHant: 一顆生洋蔥和切好的洋蔥塊
imageAlt.en: A whole raw onion and chopped onion pieces

preparation.zhHant: 生的、切碎的，沒有烹調，也沒有和其他材料混合。
preparation.en: Raw, chopped, no cooking, no other ingredients mixed in.

clues.zhHant: 洋蔥可能會讓寵物很不舒服。
clues.en: Onions can make pets feel very sick.

clues.zhHant: 剩菜裡就算煮過的洋蔥也有問題。
clues.en: Even cooked onion in leftovers is a problem.

clues.zhHant: 這不是狗或貓的點心。
clues.en: This is not a treat for dogs or cats.

explanation.zhHant: 洋蔥對狗和貓都不安全。請放在一旁並告訴大人——千萬不要把洋蔥給寵物。
explanation.en: Onion is not safe for dogs or cats. Put it aside and tell a grown-up — never offer onion to a pet.

imageAlt.zhHant: 沒有調味的軟熟胡蘿蔔片
imageAlt.en: Soft cooked carrot slices without seasoning

preparation.zhHant: 蒸至軟熟後放涼，沒有牛油、沒有鹽、沒有蜜糖釉。
preparation.en: Steamed until soft, cooled, no butter, no salt, no honey glaze.

clues.zhHant: 軟軟的小塊比較好咬。
clues.en: Soft pieces are easier to chew.

clues.zhHant: 狗常常喜歡清淡的胡蘿蔔。
clues.en: Dogs often enjoy plain carrot.

clues.zhHant: 貓通常比較喜歡肉類食物，胡蘿蔔不是貓的首選。
clues.en: Cats usually prefer meaty foods, so carrot is not a cat favourite.

explanation.zhHant: 大人同意時，清煮胡蘿蔔可以當狗的脆脆或軟軟點心想法。對貓來說不是有用的食物選擇。
explanation.en: Plain cooked carrot can be a crunchy or soft snack idea for dogs when a grown-up agrees. It is not a useful food choice for cats.

imageAlt.en: A small cluster of fresh purple grapes

preparation.zhHant: 新鮮整顆葡萄，已清洗，尚未去梗。
preparation.en: Fresh whole grapes, washed, no stems removed yet.

clues.zhHant: 葡萄和提子乾可能對狗很危險。
clues.en: Grapes and raisins can be dangerous for dogs.

clues.zhHant: 貓也不應該吃葡萄。
clues.en: Cats should not eat grapes either.

clues.zhHant: 如果在寵物碗附近看到葡萄，立刻問大人。
clues.en: If you see grapes near pet bowls, ask a grown-up right away.

explanation.zhHant: 葡萄對狗和貓都不安全。請離寵物遠一點，並請大人幫忙。
explanation.en: Grapes are not safe for dogs or cats. Keep them away from pets and ask a grown-up for help.

imageAlt.zhHant: 一碗蓋著的混合剩菜，成分不明
imageAlt.en: A covered bowl of mixed leftovers with unknown ingredients

preparation.zhHant: 蓋著的混合剩菜。標籤缺失。氣味和成分都不清楚。
preparation.en: Covered mixed leftovers. Label is missing. Smell and ingredients are unknown.

clues.zhHant: 我們看不到每樣材料。
clues.en: We cannot see every ingredient.

clues.zhHant: 盤中剩菜可能有洋蔥、鹽或醬汁。
clues.en: Plate scraps may include onion, salt or sauce.

clues.zhHant: 資料不足時，要先問大人。
clues.en: When information is missing, ask a grown-up.

explanation.zhHant: 重要細節缺失，所以安全答案是「先問大人」。精選消費前剩餘食物和盤中剩菜或腐壞食物不同——不要猜。
explanation.en: Important details are missing, so the safe answer is Ask a grown-up. Selected pre-consumer surplus is different from plate scraps or spoiled food — never guess.

imageAlt.zhHant: 去骨後的清煮白魚肉片
imageAlt.en: Flaked plain cooked white fish without bones

preparation.zhHant: 完全煮熟，仔細去骨，沒有油、沒有檸檬牛油，已放涼。
preparation.en: Fully cooked, carefully deboned, no oil, no lemon butter, cooled.

clues.zhHant: 一定要去掉骨頭。
clues.en: Bones must be removed.

clues.zhHant: 大人同意時，清淡魚肉可能適合貓和狗。
clues.en: Plain fish can suit cats and dogs when a grown-up approves.

clues.zhHant: 餐廳調味魚和清煮魚不一樣。
clues.en: Seasoned restaurant fish is not the same as plain fish.

explanation.zhHant: 大人檢查後，去骨的清煮魚可能適合狗和貓。這不是食譜或份量指引。
explanation.en: Plain, boneless cooked fish can be okay for dogs and cats after a grown-up checks. This is not a recipe or portion guide.

imageAlt.zhHant: 餐巾上的一塊朱古力布朗尼
imageAlt.en: A square chocolate brownie on a napkin

preparation.zhHant: 烤焗朱古力甜品，有糖、可可和牛油。
preparation.en: Baked chocolate dessert with sugar, cocoa and butter.

clues.zhHant: 朱古力可能讓寵物病得很重。
clues.en: Chocolate can make pets very ill.

clues.zhHant: 甜品是人吃的，不是寵物食物。
clues.en: Sweet desserts are people food, not pet food.

clues.zhHant: 即使一小塊也應該留給人。
clues.en: Even a small piece should stay with people.

explanation.zhHant: 朱古力對狗和貓都不安全。把布朗尼留給人，如果寵物可能吃了，要告訴大人。
explanation.en: Chocolate is not safe for dogs or cats. Save the brownie for people and tell a grown-up if a pet might have eaten some.

imageAlt.zhHant: 打開的吞拿魚罐頭，標籤看不清
imageAlt.en: An open tin of tuna with an unreadable label

preparation.zhHant: 已打開的罐頭。標籤撕破。不知道是浸水、浸油還是調味醬。
preparation.en: Open tin. Label torn. Unknown if packed in water, oil or flavoured sauce.

clues.zhHant: 油和調味醬會改變是否安全。
clues.en: Oil and flavoured sauces change what is safe.

clues.zhHant: 我們看不到完整標籤。
clues.en: We cannot read the full label.

clues.zhHant: 資料不足就要先問大人。
clues.en: Missing information means ask a grown-up.

explanation.zhHant: 因為浸泡液體和調味不明，決定前先問大人。不要自己用不明罐頭餵寵物。
explanation.en: Because the packing liquid and seasonings are unknown, ask a grown-up before deciding. Never feed from an unknown tin on your own.

imageAlt.zhHant: 盤子上的原味嫩豆腐塊，沒有調味
imageAlt.en: Plain firm tofu cubes on a plate, no seasoning

preparation.zhHant: 原味板豆腐，切小塊，沒有鹽、沒有醬油、沒有辣椒，新鮮放涼。
preparation.en: Plain firm tofu, cut into small cubes, no salt, no soy sauce, no chilli, cool and fresh.

clues.zhHant: 沒有調味的豆腐，和滷味豆腐不一樣。
clues.en: Plain tofu is not the same as seasoned braised tofu.

clues.zhHant: 狗有時可以吃一點原味豆腐，但要先問大人。
clues.en: Dogs can sometimes share a little plain tofu when a grown-up says yes.

clues.zhHant: 貓通常更需要肉類食物，豆腐不是貓的首選。
clues.en: Cats usually need meaty foods, so tofu is not a useful choice for cats.

explanation.zhHant: 原味、無調味的豆腐，大人同意時可以當狗的點心想法。對貓來說不是有用的選擇。這不是份量指引。
explanation.en: Plain, unseasoned tofu can be a snack idea for dogs when a grown-up agrees. It is not a useful food choice for cats. This is not a portion guide.

imageAlt.zhHant: 盤子上的一片生三文魚刺身
imageAlt.en: A piece of raw salmon fillet on a plate

preparation.zhHant: 生的三文魚片，未煮熟，沒有醬汁，但處理過程不明。
preparation.en: Raw salmon fillet, uncooked, no sauce, handling history unknown.

clues.zhHant: 生魚可能有寄生蟲或細菌風險。
clues.en: Raw fish can carry parasite or bacteria risks.

clues.zhHant: 清煮熟透的魚，和生魚不一樣。
clues.en: Fully cooked plain fish is not the same as raw fish.

clues.zhHant: 不要把壽司或生魚片直接給寵物。
clues.en: Do not offer sushi or raw fish to pets on your own.

explanation.zhHant: 生三文魚對狗和貓都不適合當檢查遊戲裡的安全選擇。請放著並告訴大人——真正餵食前一定要問大人。
explanation.en: Raw salmon is not a safe choice for dogs or cats in this inspection game. Set it aside and tell a grown-up — always ask before feeding a real pet.
